title: Approving and Charging Receipt-Based Damage Fees — Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
A receipt-based Cleaning and Damage Fees damage report under review is approved at the damage level it holds and its fee is charged to the rider who requested the trip in the same step; the fee charged on approval is the amount booked as the fee charge. The receipt-based levels are Damage Fee (Interior Repair) and Damage Fee (Exterior Repair).

## Effect of an approval

The assessment moves to charged, its assessed fee becomes the fee charged and its charge date becomes the day of the approval; one fee charge entry for the amount is booked on the assessment ledger at the level held, the net fee billed to the rider rises by the same amount, and the rider's card on file is charged that amount.

## When the fee is fixed

A damage fee charged on approval is fixed only after the repair amount on file is no more than the Wayfare repair schedule estimate for the repair increased by the schedule tolerance.

## The rider's other charged assessments

A damage fee is charged to a rider only after each earlier charged fee assessment of that rider is held at a level whose entry gate lists its incident category and, where that level is below the level its fee was charged at, carries a level-difference refund booked at the level it is held at.

## Tool card: `approve_damage_fee_charge_55ca59de`

**Capability.** Approves a damage fee report under review at the receipt-based level it holds and charges the fee to the rider who requested the trip. The assessment moves to charged, its assessed fee becomes the fee charged and its charge date becomes today; a fee charge entry for the amount is booked on the assessment ledger and the net fee billed to the rider rises by the same amount. The rider's card on file is charged that amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `approve_damage_fee_charge_55ca59de` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `damage_assessment_id` | the reference number of the damage fee assessment being approved, as returned by the assessment lookup | identifier |
| `trip_id` | the reference number of the trip the assessment is for, as shown on the assessment and the trip lookup | identifier |
| `driver_customer_id` | the customer reference number of the driver who made the report, as shown on the assessment | identifier |
| `fee_charged` | the damage fee charged to the rider on approval | US dollars as a decimal number rounded half up to 2 decimal places, for example 512.40 |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` ("charged" once the approval and the charge have landed), `damage_assessment_id`, `damage_event_id` (the reference number of the fee charge entry), `trip_id`, `driver_customer_id` (the reporting driver's customer reference number), `fee_level` (the level charged), `fee_charged` (US dollars with 2 decimal places), `charged_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `net_fee_billed` (the net fee now billed on the assessment, US dollars with 2 decimal places).
